headline: Weathered Expanse Swings Back as Dead Lands Flag Reclaimed
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has swung back, five works under Colonial colors against four Warden, after fresh flag action at Frostmarch, that front's busiest post. The fighting there is the day's heaviest: better than 9,600 Colonial and 12,300 Warden casualties in twenty-four hours, the latest hour alone near 750 and 1,150. In the Dead Lands the Warden flag raised at Callahan's Gate has come down, all eleven works standing Colonial once more. The Linn of Mercy has heated anew about Rotdust, Warden losses there climbing sharply, its roll unmoved at one Warden work among eleven. Marban Hollow saw fresh flag work at Mox without change to its eight Colonial works, and Mooring County's toll mounts fast — above a thousand to each side in two hours — though its twelve works stand eleven Warden to one Colonial. Callahan's Passage, second in the day's reckoning though quiet by the flag ledger since the small hours, keeps all ten works under Warden colors. Godcrofts' busy day has stilled, its nine works Colonial throughout; Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf show no flag movement these two hours, their five-to-four splits unmoved. The ledger reads 300 Colonial works to 136 Warden, a net shift of two since our last edition. Day 245; no victor declared.
